title: /launch is one page: it shows what the account already has, ticked, with a progress ring and a bar per section

source.ref: Vera guided launch system. The owner ruled on 2026-10-28 that every way in lands on one page that checks the account, shows what is done, and keeps an active to-do with progress graphs; design approved 2026-10-29.

verify.note: lib/launch/inventory.test.ts and overview.test.ts (run by the test job) pin the rules. The probe reads the wiring: /launch loads the inventory from the Space and its rows and draws the overview from the model with tokens only. Fails on main, where /launch is a single resume card.

detail: Spotlight, Space, Website, Email and Schedule sections, each item done only when a real record says so, with the record's own value shown. A missing cover or logo is an inspiring, skippable photo item. Not here: persisting a skip, the photo upload tray, the clock on this page, every entry routing to /launch.
